title: The Kerns Couple, 1920s Oak Harbor Ohio B&W Snapshot Photograph
description: A full-length snapshot of a man and woman identified in handwritten blue ink on the front as 'the Kerns in Oak Harbor Ohio'. Dressed in refined 1920s fashion, the woman wears a cloche hat and a heavy coat with a fur collar, while the man wears a three-piece suit, necktie, and fedora. They stand in a grassy yard beside a two-story home with a covered porch, with lush trees and a water tower visible in the background background.
